summary: First-run full E2E test for ShuruKar marketing site. Executed 12 pytest backend cases covering /submit-idea validators (mobile format, prefix, consent, age_group), needs_inspiration flow, /stats structure + increment, /recent-submissions anonymisation, /admin/export.csv, and /upload+/files/{path} for PNG happy path + txt/exe rejection — ALL 12 PASSED. Ran Playwright UI tests on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) covering title, hero, all 9 sections' data-testids, animated counters (safar-counter-0 reached '50,000+', stat-total-ideas '5,130'), sticky nav anchors, form empty-submit Hinglish validation, mobile field junk rejection & 10-digit cap, happy-path submission -> submit-success with share links + submit-another reset, toggle-no-idea hiding idea/stage + successful submission, mobile menu toggle + all 4 links, sticky-cta hidden at top and visible after scroll, no horizontal overflow, zero console/js errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/stats today count uses string $gte on ISO datetime — works today but is fragile; prefer storing created_at as native datetime and querying via datetime objects.
submit_idea has no rate-limiting or captcha — public endpoint could be spammed (medium priority for launch).
Confirmation email sending uses asyncio.create_task without exception boundary at task level (handled inside fn but no retry) — acceptable for MVP.
No cleanup of TEST_ prefixed submissions from DB — consider a delete-by-prefix admin endpoint or tag test rows.
seed_data_creation: Test submissions inserted via API with mobile 9876543210/9800000001/9800000002 and TEST names during runs. total_ideas baseline was 5127, now ~5130+.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is idempotent and safe to re-run. It relies on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env fallback to preview URL. Playwright covered all 9 sections + form flows; if UI changes, key data-testids referenced: nav-link-why/features/movement/submit, nav-cta, why-question-0..4, mentor-chip-24×7, feature-card-0..4, city-chip-Jaipur, safar-counter-0..3, milestone-3, stat-total-ideas/cities/today, age-chart, feed-item-0, sticky-cta, nav-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, input-name/mobile/city/email/idea, chip-age-*, chip-stage-*, toggle-no-idea, checkbox-consent, submit-idea-btn, submit-success, submit-another, share-whatsapp/x/instagram.
